_comment: Quality floor gates for every phase. A phase advances only when ALL applicable gates pass.

gates.pass: exit 0, all suites green, no weakened tests (compare suite/check counts to baseline)
hashes match, no prohibited terminology in live records, licenses exact + uncertainty explicit
required reviewers PASS, no unresolved critical/major findings
verdict PASS against registry acceptance criteria
one focused commit, LOCAL HEAD == REMOTE HEAD, tree clean
live manifest count, runtime 200s, correct bundle, buffer==CSSxDPR (production-facing phases)
